name: Behavioral Interviews
title: The behavioural round, drilled: real stories, clean structure, unmistakable signal.
lede: A mock focused on the behavioural round — leadership, conflict, influence, failure, ownership. We run realistic prompts, then I help you shape your experiences into tight, high-signal stories that show the seniority interviewers are actually listening for.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if it isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Facing a behavioural or leadership round soon
Rambling through stories without a clear point
Unsure which experiences send the strongest signal
Preparing for values-based interviews at big tech
notForYou: You want a product sense, metrics, or strategy round instead
You want a full resume rewrite (book Resume Review)
You want written feedback, not a live mock

howItWorks.d: Checkout in your local currency and you'll be handed straight to booking.
Pick a slot and share your target role, level, and any values or competencies to focus on.
Realistic behavioural prompts, on Google Meet — you answer as if it's the real round.
We reshape your stories into tight, high-signal answers and build a small, reusable story bank.

deliverables: A structure that keeps stories tight and on-point
A small story bank mapped to common competencies
Sharper framing of your impact, ownership, and judgement
Honest feedback on where your answers lost signal
The specific fixes to practice before the real round

faq.a: Your judgement, leadership, and how you operate with others — drawn from real past experiences. Interviewers listen for specific signal: ownership, influence, handling conflict, learning from failure.
STAR is a starting point, but strong answers go beyond a rigid template. We focus on choosing the right story and telling it with the signal a senior interviewer is scoring for.

faq.q: What if my experience feels thin?
faq.a: Most people have far more material than they realise. Part of the session is mining your background for stories you're overlooking and framing them well.

finalCta.title: Tell stories that land.
finalCta.sub: Book a focused mock and leave with a story bank and a structure that works.
